g.text: UML - explicit preview review, atomic proof and post-commit response loss
Read exact approved preview and check explicit review statement
Authenticate current customer / canonical account owner
Recheck and SHARE-lock current person link and active OWNER
Derive original native V1 material; verify policy integrity/product
Require displayed digest; fixed statement and server UTC clock
Atomically retain receipt + private attribution + request mapping + redacted event
Verify original immutable receipt / scope / private attribution
Validate full typed V1 proof before transaction commit
Retry original key/body or GET own saved review
Verify exact retained record; no current-policy regeneration
Same original receipt UUID / reviewed time / material / hashes
PREVIEW_REVIEW_ONLY. No financial consent, enrollment, activation or posting.
Saved historical material does not certify current live policy validity.
